items.q: On the same bill,was a big Swiss orchestra with whom I had worked two years before, "The friends of Jazz", from Cortaillod,under the leadership of Henri Du Paquier, sax-tenor, with Etienne Perret,trumpet

ctx.x: The festival of wine in Neuchatel is to celebrate the harvest of grapes to make wine and it's a three days celebration. This year, it takes place from the 5th to the 7th of October. Several other orchestras played at the same place as I, but the band who was engaged to play at-the-same-place-as-I with me was the New Ragtime Band from Porrentruy. I never saw so much wine passing around me before.(Neuchatel wine is a very dry white wine). It is difficult to imagine how many gallons or barrels of it was consumed…

On the same bill,was a big Swiss orchestra with whom I had worked two years before, "The friends of Jazz", from Cortaillod,under the leadership of Henri Du Paquier, sax-tenor, with Etienne Perret,trumpet, I was surprised and delighted to hear how much they had improved, and they had a big success.(Cortaillod is a small town near Neuchatel).

The "Genoa dixieland All Stars" did not loose any time in arranging some concerts in their part of Italy. Lily and I flew to Genoa the 17th of October and the first concert was that night in a town called Novi Ligure, a few miles from Genoa. The second concert was at the club the orchestra owns in Genoa. It was quite a large place and I was told after the concert that there had never been so many people in that club as there were that night.
